newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases on crude in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases on crude in quiet market.

text.p: NWE naphtha eased on Monday as it played catch-up with falls in related crude futures at the end of last week, traders said.
July IPE futures were trading five cents lower at $17.65 a barrel at 1700 GMT having shed 62 cents late on Friday.
Swaps were talked around $179.50/$181.00 cif NWE a tonne for June and July.
On the physical side there was very little activity. Pipeline spec material was bid and offered around $182/$185 cif NWE, while Dow spec material was priced at quotes cif hi +$1.50/+$4.0.
Traders said the market was quiet with many players getting back into the market having been absent on Friday due to an industry function in Scandinavia.
